name: FabMenu
description: A round floating button at the bottom-right that is itself the menu: one element morphs (width, height, radius) into a panel that grows up and left out of the corner. It opens on a list of items; choosing one slides to that item's level, with a back arrow. Lifted from mattquinn.ca's OS menu (its timings) and Ringmaster's New task button.
usage: `items`: each a label, an optional icon and its `content` (the level). Every level stays mounted, open or closed, so a half-typed draft survives going back and forth and closing

Controlled or not, as Popover and Menu: `open` and `onOpenChange`, or `defaultOpen` (useControlled). The routes that close it (Escape, a press outside, the cross) ask through onOpenChange; the app can close it by setting open to false
`fill` and `fillText`: the closed button's colours (the site's cream, #f5e9cf, with dark text). They are props the app passes, not tokens. Open, it is always the elevated surface
Fixed to the screen's bottom-right corner, clear of the safe-area insets. `className="absolute"` puts it in a positioned box instead (the demo's stage)
It reopens on the level it was left on
Escape steps back from a level to the list first, then closes, as the site's menu does
design: Closed: a 56 px circle (radius 28 px, half its size, never radius-full: a 9999 px radius squares the corners mid-morph) 1.5rem from the bottom-right corner plus the safe-area insets, elevation-3 and a hairline border-subtle ring

Open: `width` (default 20rem, capped at the screen less 1.5rem a side), as tall as the level on screen plus the button's 56 px row (capped at 100dvh less 6rem; a long level scrolls inside), radius-xl, the elevated surface

Open: width and height over 460 ms (--duration-morph) on --ease-spring, which overshoots and settles; the radius on --ease-spring-out. Close: all three over 260 ms (--duration-shift) on --ease-spring-out, no bounce. A change of level re-springs the height

The fill switches between the button's colour and the panel's in one step, at 180 ms opening and 160 ms closing (a zero-length transition, delayed), never blended: a cream blended toward a dark surface goes taupe
The contents keep the open width, anchored right, so nothing reflows mid-morph; they fade in over 160 ms and rise 6 px (320 ms on the spring), from 180 ms. Closing, they fade and sink over 160 ms
The mark: three hairlines (the last short) fold into a cross over 260 ms on spring-out; glyph="plus" turns a plus 45 degrees instead. The cross is muted text on the panel
A level slides in from the right over 260 ms on spring-out as the list slides out left; back reverses it. The level's head is a back arrow with the item's name

The close always settles: it waits on every transition still running in the panel (one cancelled or retargeted mid-way starts another, which is waited on too), and a safety net ends it at 300 ms unless one is paused on purpose. Settled, the contents are hidden (still mounted) and data-closing clears
Under Reduce Motion there is no morph: the shape and fill change in one step, the contents only fade (160 ms, no rise), levels switch without sliding
accessibility: The button has an accessible name (Open <label> / Close <label>) and aria-expanded
The open panel is role="dialog" named by `label`; closed, it is inert and aria-hidden. The list or levels not on screen are inert

Focus moves into the contents on open (the first row, or the level's first control, else its back arrow), into a level when one is chosen, to the row that opened it on back, and to the button on close (useDialogFocus, shared with Modal and Drawer: Tab wraps inside the panel)
Escape answers only from the top dialog and not when a widget inside claimed it (preventDefault)
A press outside closes it; a press inside another dialog or popup (a Popover, Menu, sheet or image viewer opened from a level) doesn't
The back arrow is named Back from <item>

props.name: items
props.type: FabMenuItem[] ({ id?: string; label: string; icon?: ElementType<LucideProps>; content: ReactNode })
props.description: The list's rows and their levels; `id` is the key (the label when left out)

props.name: label
props.description: The panel's accessible name; the button reads Open <label> and Close <label>

props.name: fill
props.description: The closed button's background, any CSS colour

props.name: fillText
props.description: The closed button's mark colour on fill

props.name: glyph
props.description: The button's mark: three lines that fold into a cross, or a plus that turns into one

props.name: width
props.description: The open panel's width, any CSS length; capped at the screen less 1.5rem a side

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled: whether it's open. Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called on every open and close it asks for (the button, Escape, a press outside)

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the panel (the element that morphs); `absolute` places it in a positioned box instead of the screen's corner
